title: Nourishing Roasted Irish Duck Legs Tagine
description: A romantic Irish dish featuring roasted duck legs cooked in a tagine with a glassy jelly sauce, suitable for a Jain-friendly diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the duck legs with salt, black pepper, and tagine spice blend.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck legs until browned on all sides, then remove from pot.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional minute.
Add the prunes, honey, apple cider vinegar, and browned duck legs to the pot.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast for 30 minutes, then reduce heat to 300 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.
